name: Unlinked
description: See what a dapp leaks, check its code against public builds, and send its RPC reads through anon-rpc.
//permissions: offscreen hosts the anon-rpc harness (a service worker has no DOM for its sandboxed iframe); webRequest observes, never blocks, what each tab sends where; storage keeps settings and caches on this device only.
//content_scripts: main-world.js must run in the page's world to see its fetch calls and wallet; content.js runs isolated, where the page can't reach the asset hashing or the modal.
//sandbox: The anon-rpc §6 boundary: the worker bundle runs at an opaque origin with its own CSP. blob: in script-src is required because the worker runtime and bundle are importScripts'd from blob URLs.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' blob:; child-src 'self' blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src *;
